agent.name: agent
agent.summary: Status (idle, running or compacting), model, thinking effort, permission mode and plan / swarm / tower mode switches of one subscribed agent, sent when a connection starts receiving that agent and on every change; it replaces the client copy. Request retries ride on the running turn.
agent.title: Agent

context.name: context
context.summary: Context window usage of one subscribed agent, sent when a connection starts receiving that agent and then at most a few times per second while it changes; only the latest value matters.
context.title: Context

goal.name: goal
goal.summary: Goal of the main agent, sent when a connection starts receiving it and on every change; goal is omitted when the session has none.
goal.title: Goal

interaction.name: interaction
interaction.summary: Flat, unsequenced approval or question state for a subscribed session; pending interactions are re-sent after every accepted subscription.
interaction.title: Interaction

item.name: item
item.summary: item.started or item.ended with the full item; it replaces the client copy of the item with the same item_id. item.ended is sent once per item, again only for a later authoritative replacement.
item.title: Item

item_delta.name: item.delta
item_delta.summary: Text appended to field of a running item: text of assistant_message and reasoning, input_text and output of tool_call.
item_delta.title: Item Delta

item_removed.name: item.removed
item_removed.summary: A running item that will not be finished, for example after a request retry restarts the step.
item_removed.title: Item Removed

item_updated.name: item.updated
item_updated.summary: Fields of a running tool_call item that changed; set is merged shallowly into the client copy.
item_updated.title: Item Updated

notice.name: notice
notice.summary: Live warning or error raised by an agent, such as a context compaction that did not finish; not part of the turns and not sent again on subscribe.
notice.title: Notice

ping.name: ping
ping.summary: Heartbeat sent by the server every 10 seconds; clients answer with pong. The server closes a connection that sends nothing for 20 seconds, and a client that receives nothing for 25 seconds should reconnect.
ping.title: Ping

response.name: response
response.summary: Reply to one client command, matched by request_id; code 0 means success. Replies to task.watch, task.stop and task.background carry the task state. A command without a request_id closes the connection with code 1008.
response.title: Response

session_event.name: session_event
session_event.summary: Flat global event sent to every connection with event_created_at and its full state.
session_event.title: Session Event

subscribe.name: subscribe
subscribe.summary: Start receiving agents of one session (agent_ids defaults to the main agent). The response comes first; then every newly added agent gets a turns frame with its latest page, or turns.failed when its conversation cannot be loaded, then turn, item and notice frames. When the session itself cannot be opened, the response carries the error code (40401 when it does not exist) and nothing is subscribed.
subscribe.title: Subscribe

task.name: task
task.summary: Full state of one task of a subscribed agent, sent on every change; the frame for an ended task is its last one.
task.title: Task

task_background.name: task.background
task_background.summary: Stop the tool call that started a task from waiting for it, so the task keeps running in the background; the response carries its state.
task_background.title: Task Background

task_list.name: task.list
task_list.summary: Every task an agent is running right now, sent when a connection starts receiving that agent; it replaces the client list.
task_list.title: Task List

task_output.name: task.output
task_output.summary: Task output starting at a UTF-8 byte offset, sent only to connections watching the task.
task_output.title: Task Output

task_stop.name: task.stop
task_stop.summary: Stop one task; the response carries its state, and an ended task just replies with it.
task_stop.title: Task Stop

task_unwatch.name: task.unwatch
task_unwatch.summary: Stop streaming one task's output to this connection.
task_unwatch.title: Task Unwatch

task_watch.name: task.watch
task_watch.summary: Stream the output of one task owned by agent_id to this connection without a session subscription. The first chunk covers at most tail_bytes; since_offset resumes after output the client already has.
task_watch.title: Task Watch

todo.name: todo
todo.summary: Todo list of one subscribed agent, sent when a connection starts receiving that agent and on every change, including undo; it replaces the client list.
todo.title: Todo

turn.name: turn
turn.summary: turn.started or turn.ended with the turn without its items; it replaces the client copy of the turn and keeps its items. turn.ended is sent again when an ended turn is corrected.
turn.title: Turn

turn_updated.name: turn.updated
turn_updated.summary: A step of a running turn ended (step, written into steps by index) or its retry state changed; retry replaces the client copy and an absent retry clears it.
turn_updated.title: Turn Updated

turns.name: turns
turns.summary: Latest page of turns of an agent, sent when a connection starts receiving that agent, including after a reconnect; it replaces the client copy of those turns. Older pages come from GET /sessions/{session_id}/agents/{agent_id}/turns.
turns.title: Turns

turns_failed.name: turns.failed
turns_failed.summary: The conversation of a subscribed agent could not be loaded; code and msg say why. The agent stays subscribed, and a later turns frame replaces the failure.
turns_failed.title: Turns Failed

turns_removed.name: turns.removed
turns_removed.summary: Turns that left the conversation of an agent, in ordinal order: the undone turns after an undo, matching removed_turn_ids of the undo response, or every turn after a context clear. The client removes them by turn_id.
turns_removed.title: Turns Removed

unsubscribe.name: unsubscribe
unsubscribe.summary: Stop receiving agents of one session; without agent_ids the whole session is dropped.
unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe

info.description: WebSocket protocol for Kimi Code daemon commands, their responses, heartbeat frames, and session event streaming.
info.title: Kimi Code WebSocket API
